I had a very disappointing experience at this clinic. I was charged over $1,500, yet my dog showed no real improvement. He still wasn’t eating, and instead of addressing that concern seriously, they continued prescribing food without identifying the underlying issue. Unfortunately, it turned out he had cancer, which was never properly diagnosed during our visits.

Even during my follow-up appointment, the actual doctor was not present. I was seen by an assistant who had little to no information about my dog’s case and was unable to provide any meaningful guidance or follow-up details. The visit felt unhelpful and ultimately pointless.

What made this even more upsetting was that after I had to make the difficult decision to put him down, the clinic continued reaching out about vaccines and routine shots without ever asking how he was doing. It felt impersonal and more focused on generating revenue than providing compassionate care.

Based on my experience, I would not recommend this clinic.

My dog is now slowly recovering, and I couldn’t be more thankful for their dedication and genuine care. You can tell they truly love what they do and treat every pet like family. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinary clinic.

I want to share my experience. I've known this clinic for a while, and especially Dr. Maikel. From the moment I saw him, I got the best feeling about his love for his work and for animals. My dog ​​Fiona had something wrong with her paw three years ago that no one could cure until the doctor came along. One session and more. It never came back. Just a few days ago, my dog ​​Fiona had to go to the emergency clinic Doral Animal Center at 4:00 AM because she had pyometra. Their priority was money, and they charged a fortune—$4,500—without even seeing her. I paid them at 4:00 AM, and by 11:00 AM, my dog ​​still hadn't gone into surgery. I spoke with the doctor, and he told me to bring her in, which I did. An hour and a half later, Fiona was out of surgery, and two days later, she was walking and very happy. And I have to say, it was cheaper than the clinic I mentioned earlier. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic and Dr. Maike. Doctor, thank you so much for what you did and continue to do.

Last year, I brought my dog, Cissa, in for tests and treatment, and I paid a significant amount of money for their services. Despite this, I later learned that they completely missed a critical issue – my dog had, a large aggressive tumor in her bladder that was dangerously, close to causing her bladder to explode.

The most concerning part is that the vets never mentioned the tumor to me, nor did they take any action or suggest further testing. It was only after the situation became life-threatening that we sought care from another vet, who promptly discovered the tumor and performed emergency surgery. Thankfully, Cissa survived and is recovering, but this experience could have been avoided.

It’s hard to trust a clinic that misses something so serious, especially when it puts the health and life of your pet at risk. I would strongly advise other pet owners to be cautious and make sure to seek a second opinion if something doesn’t feel right. I’m grateful that we found a team that truly cared for my dog’s well-being, but I’m incredibly disappointed in the negligence shown by this clinic.
